bodyHtml:
Environmental translation services for the green economy

October 23, 2019
Business Tips | Globalisation | Marketing

Environmental translation supports every part of the green economy, from wind farm tenders and environmental impact assessments to sustainability reports and safety data sheets. If your organisation sells clean technology, reports on emissions or works in energy, accurate translation helps you win contracts, meet regulations and reach investors in other markets.

BeTranslated provides environmental translation services for UK businesses that operate across borders, with specialist linguists who know the terminology of the sector.

Why the green economy needs specialist translation

The shift to low-carbon energy is global, and so is the paperwork that comes with it. Ember's Global Electricity Review 2025 found that low-carbon sources supplied 40.9 per cent of the world's electricity in 2024, the first time since the 1940s that they passed 40 per cent. Wind and solar together overtook hydro for the first time.

Policy is moving in the same direction. The UK has a legal target of net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050 under the Climate Change Act 2008, as amended in 2019. The European Commission has set a goal of cutting EU net emissions by at least 55 per cent by 2030, and it sets out the targets on its European Green Deal pages.

Each of these commitments creates projects, and each project creates documents that cross languages.

Which documents does an environmental translation agency handle?

Environmental and renewable energy work produces a wide range of text. Typical files include:

  • Environmental impact assessments and planning submissions
  • Permits, licences and compliance reports
  • Tender documents and technical specifications for wind, solar, hydro and storage projects
  • Patents and manufacturing procedures for clean technology
  • Safety data sheets, operating manuals and training materials
  • Sustainability reports, ESG disclosures and investor presentations
  • Websites, brochures and marketing content for green products

The vocabulary is technical and changes quickly. A translator who is not familiar with terms such as capacity factor, power purchase agreement or carbon offset can easily produce text that sounds plausible and is wrong.

ESG and sustainability reporting in more than one language

ESG reporting has made environmental translation a priority for many finance and operations teams. Large UK companies and limited liability partnerships have had to include climate-related financial disclosures in their annual reports since the Companies (Strategic Report) (Climate-related Financial Disclosure) Regulations 2022 came into force.

If your group has subsidiaries, investors or supply chain partners abroad, they may need those disclosures in their own language. Consistent terminology across your sustainability report, website and investor materials matters, because inconsistent wording can raise questions from auditors and stakeholders. BeTranslated's business translation and technical translation services cover this type of document.

Renewable energy, oil and gas, and energy transition projects

Energy companies rarely work in a single language. A UK developer may source turbines from Denmark, finance a project through a consortium in Asia and employ engineers from several countries, so documents move constantly between English and other languages.

Oil and gas translation follows the same pattern, and many companies in that sector now publish transition plans alongside their traditional technical documentation. Look for translators who have worked on both, so that terminology stays consistent between the two.

What makes a good environmental translator?

Subject knowledge matters as much as language skill. Look for a partner who can offer:

  • Native translators with experience in energy, engineering or environmental science
  • Terminology management, so that key terms stay consistent across projects
  • A project manager who understands tender and permit deadlines
  • Confidential handling of unpublished project data
  • Localisation for each market, including units, standards and legal references

BeTranslated matches environmental projects with linguists who have sector experience and a project manager who keeps the work on schedule. You can read more about the translation agency and its approach, or send a file for a quote.

Localising your green products for new markets

Documents are only part of the picture. If you sell solar panels, heat pumps, battery systems or consultancy, your website and product pages need to speak to buyers in their own language. Professional website translation adapts your content, keywords and calls to action for each market, and it supports your search visibility abroad.

For documents that need an official stamp, such as permits or contracts, ask about document translation with certification. Your project manager can advise on what the receiving authority is likely to ask for.

Start your environmental translation project

Tell BeTranslated about your documents, languages and deadline, and you will receive a clear quote. You can call +44 20 3026 9848, email hello@betranslated.co.uk or request a free quote online.

Frequently asked questions

What is environmental translation?

Environmental translation covers documents about energy, emissions, sustainability and environmental regulation. It includes technical files, legal and regulatory texts, reports and marketing content, and it needs translators who know the subject.

Can you translate ESG and sustainability reports?

Yes. Sustainability reports, ESG disclosures and investor presentations are common projects, and a consistent glossary keeps the terminology aligned across every language version.

Can you translate renewable energy tenders and technical specifications?

Yes. Tenders and specifications for wind, solar, hydro and storage projects go to translators with engineering or energy experience. Send the full set of files so the team can build a glossary before translation starts.

Can you translate oil and gas documents?

Technical manuals, safety documents and contracts for oil and gas are handled in the same way as renewable energy files, by translators with engineering experience. Tell the team about your project and they will confirm the right specialist for your language pair.

How do I get a quote for an environmental translation?

Send your documents, the languages you need and your deadline through the quote page. You will receive a quote before any work begins.
